verbose.description: Enable verbose (debug) logging. Only needed for troubleshooting.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the KCM daemon.

socket_path.description: Unix socket path clients use to communicate with the KCM daemon.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle requests.

default_realm.description: Default Kerberos realm for unqualified principal names.

dns_lookup_realm.description: Enable DNS SRV record lookups to discover realms (RFC 6113).

dns_lookup_kdc.description: Enable DNS SRV lookups to locate KDCs (requires DNS realm lookup).

kdc_list.description: Fallback list of KDC hostnames or hostnames with optional ports (e.g., 'kdc.example.com:88').

kadmin_list.description: Fallback list of KDCs to use for administrative operations (kadmin).

tcp_hint_kdc.description: Use TCP for KDC communication (in addition to or instead of UDP).

max_ticket_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime (in seconds) for issued tickets (e.g., 86400 = 24 hours).

max_renewable_lifetime.description: Maximum renewable lifetime (in seconds) for tickets (e.g., 604800 = 7 days).

clockskew.description: Maximum allowed clock skew (in seconds) between client and KDC.

logging_destination.description: Where to send log output: to system logging, a file, or nowhere.

logging_file.description: Path to the log file (used only if logging destination is FILE).

db_type.description: Backend database type: 'none' (in-memory, stateless KCM) or 'sql' (persistent).

sql_conn_str.description: SQL connection string (e.g., PostgreSQL or SQLite). Only used if db_type is 'sql'.

sql_schema_version.description: Internal database schema version. Do not change unless directed by documentation.

mutual_auth_required.description: Require mutual authentication in AS-REQ/AS-REP exchanges.

enforce_preauth.description: Require pre-authentication for all AS-REQ requests (security best practice).

validate_pac.description: Validate the PAC (Privilege Attribute Certificate) in tickets from Windows clients.
